home.title: Manuel Fas — Machine learning researcher and engineer
home.description: Manuel Fas, machine learning researcher and engineer in Salamanca, Spain, specialising in Transformer architectures, NLP and large language models.

experience.title: Experience — Manuel Fas
experience.description: Machine learning roles: BISITE Research Group (University of Salamanca); AIR Institute; Applied Artificial Intelligence (AAI) Lab, HSLU; Wembley Studios.

projects.title: Projects — Manuel Fas
projects.description: PyTorch reimplementation of the TRACE clickstream Transformer, a cancer survival-analysis thesis on TCGA RNA-seq data, and PyTorch paper reimplementations.

certifications.title: Certifications — Manuel Fas
certifications.description: Generative AI with Large Language Models, Deep Learning Specialization, Mathematics for Machine Learning and Data Science, and two CS50 courses.

education.title: Education — Manuel Fas
education.description: Dual B.S., Business Administration for Tech Companies and Computer Science, Pontifical University of Salamanca (UPSA); exchange at HSLU, Lucerne.

contact.title: Contact — Manuel Fas
contact.description: Contact Manuel Fas, machine learning researcher and engineer in Salamanca, Spain, by email (manuelfasruiz@gmail.com), GitHub or LinkedIn.

trace.title: Reimplementation of clickstream event sequence analysis model TRACE — Manuel Fas
trace.description: PyTorch reimplementation of the TRACE Transformer for clickstream user representations, evaluated on OTTO: average AUROC 0.787 and AUPRC 0.696.

thesis.title: Application of AI and Deep Learning to Genomic and Transcriptomic Data Analysis in Cancer — Manuel Fas
thesis.description: Bachelor's Thesis (UPSA): classical and deep survival models on TCGA breast cancer RNA-seq data. Best model: DeepSurv, C-index approximately 0.82.

reimplementations.title: Paper-Reimplementations — Manuel Fas
reimplementations.description: PyTorch reimplementations of six machine learning papers (4 completed, 2 planned/in progress), from Seq2Seq and Attention Is All You Need to ViT.

person.name: Manuel Fas
person.headline: Machine learning researcher and engineer
person.summary: Machine learning researcher and engineer with experience across three research labs in Spain and Switzerland, specialising in Transformer architectures, NLP and large language models, and deep learning for sequential, tabular and biomedical data. Reimplements state-of-the-art papers into reproducible PyTorch codebases.
